When milling steel coolant can actually shorten the life of a tool.

When a cutting edge engages into the material taking a cut, the friction increases the temperature of this edge. When the tool goes around and not cutting anything, coolant would rapidly decrease the temperature, this thermal shock can cause micro fractures in the tool edge. With enough of those micro fractures the chance of the cutting edge chipping increases. With small chips in the cutting edge you now have a very blunt cutting edge, which increases cutting forces and often result in the end mill snapping.

Since God, in the beginning, gave us humans’ dominion over the earth (Genesis 1:26), He had to speak all the words necessary through us humans, to create the seed to impregnate Mary with. Truly “the word became flesh” as John wrote (John 1:14), as the seed that created Jesus, were the words that God spoke through the prophets. Our Savior came to this world under the law brought by Moses, and lived under the law, and fulfilled it completely. He didn’t come to replace the law, but to fulfill it, and He did (Matthew 5:17).

By being perfect, Jesus brought us into relationship with God again, and being baptized into the body of Christ, we become sons of God, and the very Spirit of Jesus is sent into us, so that we appear holy in the sight of the Father. This is so awesome, that by just believing on Jesus as our Lord, and that He was raised from the dead (Romans 10:9-10), we can become sons of God along with Jesus. This is all a gift from God, and is completely by Grace (Ephesians 2:5) and has nothing to do with what we have done or not done. Most churches tend to preach that you have to live holy and do works of the law to be right with God, but that is not true, as it is a gift from God, and has nothing to do with our actions. God loves us as sons, all the time, and if you can understand the love that God has for us, you will want to live for Him. He will love you even if you don’t live holy, but the devil will make you pay if you live unholy (John 10:10), as he gains access to you through sin. Live for God, as any good son would, and glorify Him in everything you say and do. Praise God for Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
